get.description: Returns products available to administrators for moderation. Results may be filtered by status, moderation flag, flagged state or prohibited-item classification.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search by product name, slug, model number, category, brand or seller business name.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter products by their current lifecycle status.

parameters.name: moderation_flag
parameters.description: Return products that contain the selected moderation flag in their review history.

parameters.name: flagged
parameters.description: When true, return products containing at least one flagged moderation review. When false, return products without flagged reviews.

parameters.name: prohibited
parameters.description: When true, return products classified as prohibited items. When false, exclude products with prohibited-item review history.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Deterministic ordering for the moderation queue.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Number of products returned per page.

422.description: One or more moderation filters are invalid.

ProductModerationFlagValue.description: Structured marketplace policy or catalog-quality flag.

StructuredModerateProductRequest.title: Moderate product request
StructuredModerateProductRequest.description: Administrator decision for an electronics marketplace product. Approval cannot contain flags. Rejection, suspension and return-to-draft actions require a reason. Selected flags require flag notes. Prohibited flags require rejection or suspension.

reason.description: Required for rejection, suspension and return-to-draft decisions.
reason.example: The product appears to be counterfeit and cannot be listed.

notes.description: Private administrator notes. These notes must never be exposed through the public catalog.
notes.example: The serial number could not be verified against manufacturer records.

moderation_flags.description: Structured moderation flags. Send an empty array when approving a clean product.

flag_notes.description: Required whenever one or more moderation flags are selected.
flag_notes.example: The branding and serial number do not match the manufacturer information.

is_prohibited.description: Indicates that the product belongs to a prohibited or high-risk marketplace category.

requires_rejection.description: Indicates that the selected flag requires rejection or suspension.

is_correctable.description: Indicates that the seller may normally correct the issue and resubmit.

ProductModerationReviewAudit.title: Product moderation review audit
ProductModerationReviewAudit.description: Immutable history record representing one product moderation decision.

reason.example: The product appears to be counterfeit and cannot be listed.

notes.example: The seller may contact marketplace support to appeal the decision.

flag_notes.example: The device serial number and packaging do not match the manufacturer records.

UpsertProductReturnPolicyRequest.title: Create or update product return policy

is_returnable.description: Whether customers may return this product.

return_window_days.description: Number of days after fulfillment during which the customer may request a return. Required when the product is returnable.

allow_refund.description: Whether approved returns may receive a refund.

allow_exchange.description: Whether approved returns may receive an exchange.

requires_original_packaging.description: Whether the original product packaging is required.

requires_proof_of_purchase.description: Whether the customer must provide proof of purchase.

restocking_fee_percent.description: Percentage deducted as a restocking fee.

accepted_conditions.description: Product conditions accepted for return. Use values returned in the options object.

refund_methods.description: Refund methods available when allow_refund is true. Use values returned in the options object.

instructions.description: Customer-facing instructions for requesting and completing a return.
instructions.example: Contact the seller through RushPi before shipping the product back.

non_returnable_reason.description: Customer-facing explanation required when is_returnable is false.

is_active.description: Whether this return policy is currently active.

instructions.example: Contact the seller through RushPi before shipping the product back.

customer_policy.description: Customer-safe representation used by the public catalog.

ProductReturnPolicyNotConfiguredResponse.title: Product return policy not configured response

message.example: No return policy has been configured for this product.
